# A02-S12: Ownership

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

It was so nice to see you again and be part of the big event. I look forward to many more!

I have now written something about outputs and ownership, and updated the agreement period. I have also written in Computer Lars as my artist name. My novel project with him has grown quite a bit, and I think it will be extremely productive to let Computer Lars/Marcel Proust grow as an artist in this period. I have a lot of energy on that anagram.

Should we try to schedule a Zoom meeting next week? :-)
